title: US Justice Department Moves Toward Indicting Former Cuban President Raúl Castro
detail: The US Justice Department is moving toward indicting former Cuban President Raúl Castro, according to AP sources. The unprecedented legal action would target a former head of state, marking a dramatic escalation in Washington's pressure campaign against Havana. The potential indictment comes amid heightened US-Cuba tensions, including the 2026 energy blockade and ongoing debate over military options. No US administration has previously sought criminal charges against a sitting or former leader of Cuba.

media.caption: AP reports US Justice Department moving toward indicting former Cuban President Raúl Castro
